1. Description

This pairing examines annual average sea surface temperature (SST), averaged over all the world’s oceans. The nominal depth is 0.2 meters. This feature aligns with Figure 1 in EPA’s Sea Surface Temperature indicator and includes the following components:

  • Historical observations since 1880.
  • Modeled projections from 2015 to 2100 for four climate scenarios.
  • A modeled hindcast from 1880 to 2014.
